item.title: Fable 5.1 Solves the Cyphral Distich, a 370-year-old cipher
item.description:
📝 This cipher has remained seemingly unsolved for centuries. 32 numbers in the first cipher line. The rule was simple: for the i-th number in a cipher line, go to the i-th Proquiritation, use that number as a word index, and take the first letter of that word.
🔗 Read more: https://www.vals.ai/blogs/fable-solves-cyphral-distich
